name: SafeGuard Cloud Paywall
author: ArtistScope

sections.description:
This plugin nominates which pages are encrypted and diplayed in such a way that they cannot be accessed by search engines, AI bots or any other type of web scraper.

This plugin provides much better protection from search engines, AI bots and other web scapers by encrypting the pages so that browser user-agents cannot be spoofed. Only the ArtisBrowser can decrypt Safeguard Cloud pages and bots cannot use ArtisBrowser.

  • Creates a most secure tunnel between web server and the user’s desktop.
  • Simply tag pages to be protected by nominating keyword/s found in their url.
  • Can be viewed on Windows, Mac, iOS and Android phones.

ACCOUNT FEATURES

An account on the Safeguard Cloud server provides:

  • Online dashboard for page and access management.
  • Limit access to Windows, Mac, iOS or Android phones.
  • Settings can control user access per platform.
  • Manage access for bots on a pay-per-view basis.
  • Optional ACCESS RIGHTS using DRM tokens.
  • Optional COPY PROTECTION from screenshots and recording.
  • Optional WATERMARK using your own image.

BOT MANAGEMENT (Optional)

  • Allow access to bots by IP/network and user-agent.
  • Manage periodic bot billing for pay-per-view.
  • Set categories and tariff for bot usage.
  • Bot login for account management.

DRM MANAGEMENT (Optional)

  • Assign DRM tokens with OS, expiry and device limitations.
  • Allow access to users by device fingerprint or network.

COPY PROTECTION (Optional)

  • Safe from all copy including screenshots and recording.
  • No view-source, download or save options.

Note: This plugin connects to a third party service for cloud service provided by SafeGuard Media. To view protected pages, users are required to use a secure web browser known as ArtisBrowser

For more information visit the SafeGuard Cloud website.

Licensing

  • This plugin is free to use but billing management requires a SafeGuard Cloud account.
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get started.

  1. Install as with any other WordPress plugin, or
  2. Extract and upload the “safeguard-cloud-paywall” folder and its contents to “/wp-content/plugins/”.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  4. Set which pages to protect by nominating keyword/s found in their url.
  5. Check and set the default settings to Active.
  6. For help see the User-Guide

If you have problems, email us from the safeguard.media website for a faster response than the WP forum.

More Info

  • About Copy Protection
  • About Digital Rights Management
  • About Protection Techniques
